title: [BUG] Fail agressively when SDK setup fails (e.g. missing dependencies)
notes: FlutterService.setup uses run with throwOnError=false; SetupFlutterWorkflow ignores the returned exit code and logs success without rechecking isSetup. Existing test covers interruption, not ordinary nonzero exits.
